prompts.sit:
Use case: precise image edit of an existing transparent desktop-cat sprite. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact pose/style/identity/composition master. Images 2 and 3 are real photos of Odin, reference only for natural fur where the lower contact fur needs modification. Keep image 1's head/face, asymmetric eye identity, ears, whiskers, neck, shoulders, proportions, pose, colors, existing detail and style unchanged. This is a tiny LOCAL LOWER-SILHOUETTE edit, not a fresh cat illustration. Do not reframe, enlarge, recenter or restyle. Retain the 1024x1024 transparent canvas and original cat placement at the bottom with the original generous upper transparent space. Output one isolated cat on real transparent alpha, no floor, no line, no UI, no text, no cast shadow. Fully preserve the whole head and tail in frame. Fur contact must physically squash and bunch under weight into a horizontal support, with small natural irregular compressed tufts, not a ruler-cut crop, not deleted fur, not a hard geometric shelf, no procedural scratchy or curly texture. Rounded paws stay natural and may extend below the contact plane. Only modify the underside/contact fur specified below.
Pose: UPRIGHT FRONT SITTING, exactly as target. Only gently squash the bottom of left tail and haunch/body fur onto the horizontal plane at approximately source y=936; keep both front paws unchanged near y=950 so toes slightly overhang. Tail and body must not hang below the support plane. Keep upper sitting silhouette and the entire face exactly as target. Do not shorten legs or shrink body. Compress just the lowest roughly 10-15 pixels of non-paw fur upward, subtly bunched above the invisible floor.
